# SaveRunner domain

## Overview
**Id:** blk-a0e41250aa34

SaveRunner loads a save in the real game with nobody at the keyboard, runs the colony for a number of game seconds with all saving blocked, records readings once per game second and quits. It exists to reproduce an in-game observation from a player's save, with and without a mod, under real sim behaviour and the player's own mod loadout. Two parts: a development mod (`SaveRunner`, inert unless the game starts with `--saverun=FILE`) and a launcher (`Invoke-SaveRun.ps1`). It is not published to the Workshop.

## Key Entities
**Id:** blk-6e0fb1c00ac7

### SaveRunnerMod
**Id:** blk-ca4d28981335  
**Description**: the mod's entry point (`UserMod2`). Reads the command line at load; when a run is on it sets the crash-reporter flags and installs quit tracing.  
**Location**: `Mod.cs`  
**Relationships**: calls `Runner.ReadCommandLine`; traces `App.Restart` and `Application.Quit` through `TracePatch`/`TraceQuit`; the Harmony patches in `Patches.cs` are applied by `base.OnLoad`.

### Runner
**Id:** blk-b5fe6721e0d5  
**Description**: the command line and state of one run, and the way it ends.  
**Location**: `Runner.cs`

| Member | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `Active` | true when `--saverun=FILE` was given |
| `SavePath`, `Seconds`, `Speed`, `Probe`, `OutFile`, `TimeoutSeconds` | the options |
| `Started`, `Finished` | load requested; run ended |
| `StartedAt`, `MenuSeenAt` | real-time marks (`MenuSeenAt` is -1 until the main menu appears) |
| `Finish(status, detail)` | writes the status line, quits |

### Patches
**Id:** blk-4905afd4b039  
**Description**: the Harmony patches, each a no-op unless `Runner.Active`.  
**Location**: `Patches.cs`

| Patch | Target | Does |
|-------|--------|------|
| `MainMenu_OnSpawn_Patch` | `MainMenu.OnSpawn` | notes when the menu appeared |
| `App_LateUpdate_Patch` | `App.LateUpdate` | four seconds after the menu: checks the file exists and calls `LoadScreen.DoLoad(path)`; also the real-time timeout watchdog |
| `Game_OnSpawn_Patch` | `Game.OnSpawn` | adds `RunBehaviour` to the Game object once the colony is up |
| `SaveLoader_Save_Patch` | `SaveLoader.Save(string, bool, bool)` | skips the save and returns the filename |
| `App_Quit_Patch` | `App.Quit` | logs who quit, with a stack when it was not the runner |

### RunBehaviour
**Id:** blk-1f9288a97c7a  
**Description**: a `MonoBehaviour` on the Game object for one run. Unpauses and sets the speed, accumulates scaled frame time as game seconds, samples the probe once per game second, ends the run at `Runner.Seconds`.  
**Location**: `RunBehaviour.cs`  
**Relationships**: owns the CSV `StreamWriter`; calls `FridgeProbe.Sample`; ends through `Runner.Finish`.

### FridgeProbe
**Id:** blk-043bf2a0945a  
**Description**: the one probe, `fridges`. For every building with a `RefrigeratorController.Def` and every item in its `Storage`, writes controller state, powered state, whether No Magic Fridges' `FridgeThermostat` is on the building, the def's setpoint, the cell's temperature, element and mass, and per item its element, mass, temperature, `SimTemperatureTransfer` surface area and ground-transfer scale, whether that component is enabled, its sim handle and `deltaKJ`.  
**Location**: `RunBehaviour.cs`

### Invoke-SaveRun.ps1
**Id:** blk-3eb75b734c83  
**Description**: the launcher. Copies the save into the run folder, rewrites `mods.json` for the run, starts the game through Steam, waits for it to quit, restores `mods.json`, prints the status.  
**Location**: `Invoke-SaveRun.ps1`

| Parameter | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `-Save` | the `.sav` to load (required) |
| `-Seconds`, `-Speed` | game seconds (default 60) and speed 1 to 3 |
| `-Probe` | `fridges` or none |
| `-With`, `-Without` | mods to add or remove for the run |
| `-TimeoutSec`, `-Label`, `-OutDir`, `-SteamExe`, `-AppId` | real-time limit (900), run-folder prefix, output root, Steam path, game app id (457140) |

### Files it reads and writes
**Id:** blk-2c721000393a

| File | Direction | Purpose |
|------|-----------|---------|
| the save | read | copied to `runs/<Label>-<stamp>/colony.sav`; the original is never opened by the game |
| `Documents\Klei\OxygenNotIncluded\mods\mods.json` | read, write, restored | the loadout: current mods, plus SaveRunner and `-With`, minus `-Without`; backup at `mods.json.saverun-backup` |
| `kplayerprefs.yaml` | read | tells whether the game is in Spaced Out mode so `enabledForDlc` is set to match |
| `probe.csv` | written by the game | one row per item per game second, or one row for an empty fridge; written only when `--saverun-probe` is given (the launcher always passes `--saverun-out`) |
| `probe.csv.status` | written by the game | one JSON line when the run ends |
| `Player.log` | copied | into the run folder after the game exits |

## Business Rules
**Id:** blk-ae74a2604bba

- Without `--saverun` the mod changes nothing.
- Nothing is saved while a run is on: `SaveLoader.Save` is skipped, and the game opens a copy of the save.
- The game's mode (base game or Spaced Out) is left as it is; the save has to be from the current mode.
- Mod Profile Manager (Workshop 2854869130) and its Light addon (3281716506) restart the game when a save loads with a different mod list, which a run always has; disable them with `-Without 2854869130,3281716506`.
- The save path travels through Steam's command line, so the copy is named `colony.sav` in a folder without spaces.
- The launcher refuses to start when the game is already running.

## Key Code Paths
**Id:** blk-d8b4ef45566a

- **Start**: `Invoke-SaveRun.ps1` builds the arguments and runs `steam.exe -applaunch 457140 --saverun=...`; the game loads the mod, `SaveRunnerMod.OnLoad` reads the arguments. See `Mod.cs`, `Runner.cs`.
- **Load**: `MainMenu.OnSpawn` postfix notes the time; the `App.LateUpdate` postfix calls `LoadScreen.DoLoad` four seconds later. See `Patches.cs`.
- **Run**: `Game.OnSpawn` postfix adds `RunBehaviour`; it samples each game second and finishes at the time limit. See `RunBehaviour.cs`.
- **End**: `Runner.Finish` writes the status line and quits; the launcher sees the process exit, copies `Player.log`, restores `mods.json`. See `Runner.cs`, `Invoke-SaveRun.ps1`.

## State Transitions
**Id:** blk-bafa30d4781e

| State | Transitions To | Trigger |
|-------|---------------|---------|
| inactive | waiting for menu | `--saverun` given |
| waiting for menu | loading | four seconds after the menu appeared (`Runner.Started`) |
| waiting for menu | finished (`no-save`) | file not found |
| loading | running | `Game.OnSpawn`, `RunBehaviour` added |
| running | finished (`done`) | game seconds reached |
| running | finished (`runner-error`) | exception in `RunBehaviour.Update` |
| waiting for menu, loading or running | finished (`timeout`) | real time since the command line was read passes `TimeoutSeconds` before the run finishes |

## Related
**Id:** blk-bf1ccef2e930

- See also: [glossary](glossary.md)
- Governed by: [naming conventions](../standards/naming-conventions.md)

# SaveRunner glossary

Terms a newcomer to SaveRunner needs. Entity detail is in [entities](entities.md).

## Abbreviations and Acronyms
**Id:** blk-bd9fd4d15776

| Abbreviation | Full Term | Context |
|--------------|-----------|---------|
| ONI | Oxygen Not Included | the game |
| SMI | state machine instance | `RefrigeratorController.StatesInstance`, read by the fridge probe |
| STT | `SimTemperatureTransfer` | the component that exchanges heat between an item and its cell; columns `surfaceArea`, `groundTransferScale`, `sttEnabled`, `simHandle`, `deltaKJ` |
| SO | Spaced Out | the expansion; the launcher reads it from `kplayerprefs.yaml` |
| NMF | No Magic Fridges | a mod whose `FridgeThermostat` the probe looks for |

## Cross-Domain Terms
**Id:** blk-cfb3406478e6

### Run
**Id:** blk-fca79a60d4bc  
**Definition**: one game launch by `Invoke-SaveRun.ps1`: load a save, play for `--saverun-seconds` game seconds, write the probe, quit. Its folder is `runs/<Label>-<stamp>`.  
**Used in**: the launcher, `Runner`, every file name under `runs/`.

### Probe
**Id:** blk-4e73227a1e2f  
**Definition**: a named recorder sampled once per game second during a run. `fridges` is the only one.  
**Used in**: `--saverun-probe`, `RunBehaviour`, `FridgeProbe`.

### Game seconds and real seconds
**Id:** blk-dd09f79f5775  
**Definition**: game seconds are scaled frame time (speed 3 passes three of them per real second); `--saverun-seconds` is in game seconds, `--saverun-timeout` in real seconds.  
**Used in**: `RunBehaviour.Update`, `App_LateUpdate_Patch`.

### Status file
**Id:** blk-67145d475ebb  
**Definition**: `<out>.status`, one JSON line (`done`, `timeout`, `no-save` or `runner-error`) that tells the launcher how the run ended.  
**Used in**: `Runner.Finish`, the launcher's final report.

### Loadout
**Id:** blk-e9f19f346fa7  
**Definition**: the list of enabled mods in `mods.json`. A run keeps the player's loadout, adds SaveRunner and `-With`, removes `-Without`, and puts the original back afterwards.  
**Used in**: `Invoke-SaveRun.ps1` (`Set-Mods`).

### Menu settle
**Id:** blk-480a83d50352  
**Definition**: the four-second wait between the main menu appearing and the load starting. Loading straight from `MainMenu.OnSpawn` threw inside a popup that was still laying out.  
**Used in**: `App_LateUpdate_Patch`.

## Related
**Id:** blk-a61962c63d5a

- See also: [entities](entities.md)

# SaveRunner

## What this is
**Id:** blk-da4886ca7cad

SaveRunner is a development mod plus a launcher script that load a save in the real game with nobody at the keyboard, run the colony for a set number of game seconds with every save to disk blocked, record a probe's readings once per game second and quit. The mod author uses it to reproduce a player's report from their save, once with the mod under test and once without it (`-Without <Mod>`), under the real sim and the player's own loadout, and compares the two `probe.csv` files. The mod does nothing unless the game starts with `--saverun=FILE`, so it can stay installed. Version 0.1.0 in `mod_info.yaml`; not for the Workshop. Mod Profile Manager restarts the game on a changed loadout and is left out with `-Without 2854869130,3281716506`.

## Where things are
**Id:** blk-3dee2f4998e2

Files:

- `Mod.cs`: `SaveRunnerMod`, the `UserMod2` entry point. Reads the command line, sets the crash-reporter flags and traces quits.
- `Runner.cs`: `Runner`, the run's options and state, and `Finish`, which writes the status line and quits.
- `Patches.cs`: the Harmony patches on `MainMenu.OnSpawn`, `App.LateUpdate` (loads the save from the menu, timeout watchdog), `Game.OnSpawn`, `SaveLoader.Save` (blocked) and `App.Quit`.
- `RunBehaviour.cs`: `RunBehaviour`, which runs the colony and samples once per game second, and `FridgeProbe`, the `fridges` probe.
- `Invoke-SaveRun.ps1`: the launcher. Copies the save into `runs/<Label>-<stamp>/`, rewrites `mods.json` for the run (`-With`, `-Without`), starts the game through Steam, restores `mods.json` and prints the status.
- `SaveRunner.csproj`: builds the mod through `common/oni-mod.props` and `common/oni-mod.targets`, which deploy it to the local mods folder.
- `mod.yaml`, `mod_info.yaml`: title "Save Runner (dev tool)", static id `Isochronous.SaveRunner`, version 0.1.0, minimum build 744825.
- `README.md`: setup, running, the probes and how it works.
- `runs/`: created by the launcher; one folder per run with the save copy, `probe.csv`, `probe.csv.status` and `Player.log`. Ignored by `common/.gitignore`.
- `.gitattributes`: line-ending and merge rules for this node's `.context/` files.

The `.context/` documents of this node: [domains](domains/README.md) (entities, glossary), [standards](standards/README.md) (code style, error handling, naming conventions), `decisions/` and `retrospectives/`.

The mod author uses it to reproduce a player's report from their save, once with the mod under test and once without it (`-Without <Mod>`), under the real sim and the player's own loadout, and compares the two `probe.csv` files. The mod does nothing unless the game starts with `--saverun=FILE`, so it can stay installed. Version 0.1.0 in `mod_info.yaml`; not for the Workshop. Mod Profile Manager restarts the game on a changed loadout and is left out with `-Without 2854869130,3281716506`.

sections.title: Where things are
sections.text:
## Where things are
**Id:** blk-3dee2f4998e2

Files:

- `Mod.cs`: `SaveRunnerMod`, the `UserMod2` entry point. Reads the command line, sets the crash-reporter flags and traces quits.
- `Runner.cs`: `Runner`, the run's options and state, and `Finish`, which writes the status line and quits.
- `Patches.cs`: the Harmony patches on `MainMenu.OnSpawn`, `App.LateUpdate` (loads the save from the menu, timeout watchdog), `Game.OnSpawn`, `SaveLoader.Save` (blocked) and `App.Quit`.
- `RunBehaviour.cs`: `RunBehaviour`, which runs the colony and samples once per game second, and `FridgeProbe`, the `fridges` probe.
- `Invoke-SaveRun.ps1`: the launcher. Copies the save into `runs/<Label>-<stamp>/`, rewrites `mods.json` for the run (`-With`, `-Without`), starts the game through Steam, restores `mods.json` and prints the status.
- `SaveRunner.csproj`: builds the mod through `common/oni-mod.props` and `common/oni-mod.targets`, which deploy it to the local mods folder.
- `mod.yaml`, `mod_info.yaml`: title "Save Runner (dev tool)", static id `Isochronous.SaveRunner`, version 0.1.0, minimum build 744825.
- `README.md`: setup, running, the probes and how it works.
- `runs/`: created by the launcher; one folder per run with the save copy, `probe.csv`, `probe.csv.status` and `Player.log`. Ignored by `common/.gitignore`.
- `.gitattributes`: line-ending and merge rules for this node's `.context/` files.

The `.context/` documents of this node: [domains](domains/README.md) (entities, glossary), [standards](standards/README.md) (code style, error handling, naming conventions), `decisions/` and `retrospectives/`.

# Code Style Guide

## Formatting
**Id:** blk-9a324aa6540e

### Indentation
**Id:** blk-2ac58ee6eb93

- Tabs, one per level, in every `.cs` file (`Mod.cs`, `Patches.cs`, `Runner.cs`, `RunBehaviour.cs`).
- Four spaces in `Invoke-SaveRun.ps1`; two spaces in `SaveRunner.csproj` and the yaml files.

### Braces
**Id:** blk-8de1cb25887c

- Opening brace on its own line (Allman) for namespaces, types, members and multi-line blocks.
- A body of one short statement goes on the next line without braces (`if (!Runner.Active)` followed by `return;` in `Mod.cs`).
- A `switch` case with one short statement stays on one line (`ReadCommandLine` in `Runner.cs`).

### Line Length
**Id:** blk-459605aea8ce

- No limit and no `.editorconfig`. Long log lines wrap before a `+` with the continuation indented one tab (the start-up `Debug.Log` in `Mod.cs`).

## Language and Toolchain
**Id:** blk-545208d8763a

- C# 9 on .NET Framework 4.8 (`common/oni-mod.props`: `LangVersion` 9.0, `TargetFramework` net48), built against the game's own assemblies through `common/oni-mod.targets`.
- `SaveRunner.csproj` imports the props, sets `AssemblyName`, `RootNamespace` and `Version`, then imports the targets. A successful build deploys the mod to `Documents\Klei\OxygenNotIncluded\mods\local\SaveRunner`.
- The tool is a mod (`mod.yaml`, `mod_info.yaml`, `SaveRunnerMod : UserMod2`) plus one PowerShell launcher. PowerShell is run with `pwsh`.
- Namespace blocks, not file-scoped namespaces.

## Layout
**Id:** blk-233f0aed6e04

One concern per file, all in the node root:

| File | Holds |
|------|-------|
| `Mod.cs` | `SaveRunnerMod`: reads the command line at load, sets the crash-reporter flags, traces who quits |
| `Runner.cs` | `Runner`: static command-line state, `ReadCommandLine`, `Finish` |
| `Patches.cs` | the Harmony patch classes |
| `RunBehaviour.cs` | `RunBehaviour` (the per-frame driver) and `FridgeProbe` (the only probe) |
| `Invoke-SaveRun.ps1` | the launcher |

A new probe is a static class beside `FridgeProbe` with a `Sample(int t, StreamWriter writer, bool toLog)` method, a branch in `RunBehaviour.Begin` for its CSV header and one in `RunBehaviour.Sample`, and an entry in the launcher's `-Probe` `ValidateSet`.

## Inert Without the Argument
**Id:** blk-969f0779ab20

Every patch and hook starts with `if (!Runner.Active) return` (or the equivalent). The mod must stay installed and change nothing when the game starts without `--saverun`. `SaveRunnerMod.OnLoad` returns before patching the quit traces when `Runner.Active` is false.

## Harmony Patches
**Id:** blk-fa011f2987f3

- One static class per patched method, with `[HarmonyPatch(typeof(X), "Method")]` or `nameof` when the member is public, and a `Prefix` or `Postfix` inside (`Patches.cs`).
- The overload is pinned by parameter types when the method has several (`SaveLoader.Save(string, bool, bool)`).
- Private members are named by string; a patch that could be missing on another game build is applied by hand inside try/catch (`SaveRunnerMod.TracePatch`).

## Comments
**Id:** blk-9fd4a51454ee

- Types and patch classes get a `///` summary that says what the code is for and, where a bug shaped it, what went wrong: the four-second menu settle in `Patches.cs`, the crash dialog in `Mod.cs`.
- Command-line options are documented in the `///` summary of `Runner`, in the launcher's comment-based help and in `README.md`; change all three together.
- No commented-out code.

## Related
**Id:** blk-41f957f9abf7

- See also: [error handling](error-handling.md)
- See also: [naming conventions](naming-conventions.md)

# Error Handling Conventions

## Principles
**Id:** blk-225bad67d9a6

1. **A run always ends with a status.** Whatever goes wrong inside the game, `Runner.Finish` writes one JSON line to `<out>.status` and quits, so the launcher never waits on a game that has silently given up.
2. **Never write to the player's data.** The save is copied first and every `SaveLoader.Save` is blocked, so a failed run leaves the colony as it was.
3. **Leave a trace.** Anything that ends the process during a run logs its stack; every failure goes to `Player.log` under the `[SaveRunner] ` tag.
4. **Put the machine back.** The launcher restores `mods.json` in a `finally` block, whatever happened.

## Run Status
**Id:** blk-a1742b4823d2

`Runner.Finish(status, detail)` writes `{"status":..., "save":..., "detail":..., "realSeconds":...}` and calls `App.Quit()`. The first call wins (`Runner.Finished`).

| Status | Written by | Meaning |
|--------|-----------|---------|
| `done` | `RunBehaviour.Update` | the game seconds were reached; `detail` is the sample count |
| `timeout` | `App_LateUpdate_Patch` | no end after `--saverun-timeout` real seconds (default 900) |
| `no-save` | `App_LateUpdate_Patch` | the file named by `--saverun` does not exist |
| `runner-error` | `RunBehaviour.Update` | an exception in the per-frame driver; `detail` is the exception |

The launcher prints the status line, the number of probe rows and the run folder when the game has gone. A missing status file prints `(no status file: the run never finished)`.

## Handling Patterns
**Id:** blk-4db51d308caa

### Driver
**Id:** blk-dbdec23d78e3

`RunBehaviour.Update` runs its whole body in one `try`. The `catch` logs a warning, closes the CSV writer and finishes with `runner-error`. The broad catch is deliberate: an unattended run must end, with the reason recorded.

### Fire-and-forget file writes
**Id:** blk-8cfa00557d4c

Writing the status file is wrapped in its own try/catch that logs a warning (`Runner.Finish`); a failed write must not stop the quit.

### Optional hooks
**Id:** blk-c881d85c0855

`SaveRunnerMod.TracePatch` returns with a warning when the target method is missing and catches an exception from `harmony.Patch`. A game update that moves `App.Restart` costs a warning, not the mod.

### Crash dialog
**Id:** blk-07e31aa20eae

`OnLoad` sets `KCrashReporter.ignoreAll = true` and `terminateOnError = false` during a run. The game's crash dialog quits the process when the scene change destroys it, which ended runs without a word; exceptions still reach the log.

### Command line
**Id:** blk-862fa77a8e5f

`Runner.ReadCommandLine` ignores a number it cannot parse or that is not positive and keeps the default; `--saverun-speed` is clamped to 1 to 3. An unknown `--saverun-*` key is ignored.

### The launcher
**Id:** blk-aa64035a160f

`Invoke-SaveRun.ps1` sets `$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'` and checks its preconditions with `throw` and a message that names the fix: save not found, game already running, Steam not found, `SaveRunner is not deployed; run: dotnet build tools/SaveRunner -c Release`, local mod folder not found, game not started within 120 s.

- A leftover `mods.json.saverun-backup` means an earlier launcher died: it is copied back over `mods.json` first, with a warning, so the real loadout is never overwritten by a modified one.
- The game process is stopped (`Stop-Process -Force`) 60 s after the status file stops changing and `TimeoutSec + 180` s after launch, and the launcher says which (`killed-after-status`, `killed`).
- The launcher sets no exit code of its own; a `throw` ends it with PowerShell's failure exit code, and a finished run returns 0 whatever the status, so read the printed status line or `probe.csv.status`.

## Logging
**Id:** blk-f7c3dad5aad4

- All lines go through `Debug.Log` or `Debug.LogWarning` with the `Runner.Tag` prefix (`[SaveRunner] `).
- Warnings for problems the run survives; plain log lines for milestones (loading, colony loaded, running, finished, every quit call).
- Probe rows are copied to the log every tenth game second (`t % 10 == 0`) so the log shows the run progressing.

## Anti-Patterns to Avoid
**Id:** blk-1cec34c97303

- Calling `App.Quit()` directly instead of `Runner.Finish`: no status file is written.
- Loading the save from `MainMenu.OnSpawn`: the menu was torn down under a popup still laying out, which threw and opened the crash dialog. The load waits four seconds after the menu appears.
- Patching without the `Runner.Active` guard.
- Pointing the game at the original save; the launcher always copies it to the run folder.

## Related
**Id:** blk-bb6114284811

- See also: [code style](code-style.md)

# Naming Conventions

## Files and Directories
**Id:** blk-9f3b33d81a6e

- C# files are PascalCase and named for the main type they hold: `Mod.cs`, `Runner.cs`, `Patches.cs`, `RunBehaviour.cs`. `Patches.cs` holds every patch class.
- The launcher is `Invoke-SaveRun.ps1`, a PowerShell Verb-Noun name.
- The mod's folder, assembly (`SaveRunner`) and deployed folder (`mods\local\SaveRunner`) share one name. `mod.yaml` carries `staticID: "Isochronous.SaveRunner"`; the title is "Save Runner (dev tool)".
- Run output lives in `runs/<Label>-<yyyyMMdd-HHmmss>/` (ignored by `common/.gitignore`): `colony.sav`, `probe.csv`, `probe.csv.status`, `Player.log`.

## Code Naming
**Id:** blk-4cf0ed5fa17e

- Namespace `SaveRunner`; types PascalCase; locals and parameters camelCase; private fields camelCase with no prefix (`elapsed`, `samples`, `writer`).
- The mod class is `<Tool>Mod : UserMod2` (`SaveRunnerMod`).
- Patch classes are `<Type>_<Method>_Patch` (`MainMenu_OnSpawn_Patch`, `SaveLoader_Save_Patch`, `App_LateUpdate_Patch`), with methods named `Prefix` or `Postfix`.
- Run state is public static fields on `Runner` named for what they hold (`SavePath`, `Seconds`, `Speed`, `Probe`, `OutFile`, `TimeoutSeconds`); flags are `Active`, `Started`, `Finished`; times with a real-time meaning end in `At` (`StartedAt`, `MenuSeenAt`).
- A probe is a static class named `<Subject>Probe` (`FridgeProbe`) with a `Sample` method; the probe's name on the command line is the subject in lower case (`fridges`).
- Log tag: `Runner.Tag`, the string `[SaveRunner] `.

## Command Line and Launcher
**Id:** blk-5068e4f0855f

- Game arguments are `--saverun` followed by `-<option>`, lower case, hyphen-separated, as `--saverun-seconds=N`. `--saverun=FILE` itself names the save. `Runner` reads `--key=value` and a bare `--key` as an empty value.
- Launcher parameters are PowerShell PascalCase (`-Seconds`, `-Speed`, `-Probe`, `-With`, `-Without`, `-TimeoutSec`, `-Label`, `-OutDir`, `-SteamExe`, `-AppId`). `-Seconds`, `-Speed`, `-Probe` and `-TimeoutSec` map straight to `--saverun-seconds`, `--saverun-speed`, `--saverun-probe` and `--saverun-timeout`. `-Save` becomes `--saverun=<copy of the save in the run folder>`, and the run folder, named from `-OutDir` and `-Label`, gives `--saverun-out=<run folder>/probe.csv`. `-With`, `-Without`, `-SteamExe` and `-AppId` configure only the launcher: the loadout, the Steam path and the app to launch.
- `-With` and `-Without` take local mod folder names or Workshop item ids, comma-separated.
- Probe names are lower case plurals of the thing sampled (`fridges`).

## CSV Columns
**Id:** blk-885a11539bd3

Header names are camelCase with units spelled in the name (`setpointC`, `cellTempC`, `massKg`, `deltaKJ`), sample time first as `t`. Each game second writes one row per item in a fridge, or one row for a fridge with no items.

sections.title: Files and Directories
sections.text:
## Files and Directories
**Id:** blk-9f3b33d81a6e

- C# files are PascalCase and named for the main type they hold: `Mod.cs`, `Runner.cs`, `Patches.cs`, `RunBehaviour.cs`. `Patches.cs` holds every patch class.
- The launcher is `Invoke-SaveRun.ps1`, a PowerShell Verb-Noun name.
- The mod's folder, assembly (`SaveRunner`) and deployed folder (`mods\local\SaveRunner`) share one name. `mod.yaml` carries `staticID: "Isochronous.SaveRunner"`; the title is "Save Runner (dev tool)".
- Run output lives in `runs/<Label>-<yyyyMMdd-HHmmss>/` (ignored by `common/.gitignore`): `colony.sav`, `probe.csv`, `probe.csv.status`, `Player.log`.

sections.title: Code Naming
sections.text:
## Code Naming
**Id:** blk-4cf0ed5fa17e

- Namespace `SaveRunner`; types PascalCase; locals and parameters camelCase; private fields camelCase with no prefix (`elapsed`, `samples`, `writer`).
- The mod class is `<Tool>Mod : UserMod2` (`SaveRunnerMod`).
- Patch classes are `<Type>_<Method>_Patch` (`MainMenu_OnSpawn_Patch`, `SaveLoader_Save_Patch`, `App_LateUpdate_Patch`), with methods named `Prefix` or `Postfix`.
- Run state is public static fields on `Runner` named for what they hold (`SavePath`, `Seconds`, `Speed`, `Probe`, `OutFile`, `TimeoutSeconds`); flags are `Active`, `Started`, `Finished`; times with a real-time meaning end in `At` (`StartedAt`, `MenuSeenAt`).
- A probe is a static class named `<Subject>Probe` (`FridgeProbe`) with a `Sample` method; the probe's name on the command line is the subject in lower case (`fridges`).
- Log tag: `Runner.Tag`, the string `[SaveRunner] `.

sections.title: Command Line and Launcher
sections.text:
## Command Line and Launcher
**Id:** blk-5068e4f0855f

- Game arguments are `--saverun` followed by `-<option>`, lower case, hyphen-separated, as `--saverun-seconds=N`. `--saverun=FILE` itself names the save. `Runner` reads `--key=value` and a bare `--key` as an empty value.
- Launcher parameters are PowerShell PascalCase (`-Seconds`, `-Speed`, `-Probe`, `-With`, `-Without`, `-TimeoutSec`, `-Label`, `-OutDir`, `-SteamExe`, `-AppId`). `-Seconds`, `-Speed`, `-Probe` and `-TimeoutSec` map straight to `--saverun-seconds`, `--saverun-speed`, `--saverun-probe` and `--saverun-timeout`. `-Save` becomes `--saverun=<copy of the save in the run folder>`, and the run folder, named from `-OutDir` and `-Label`, gives `--saverun-out=<run folder>/probe.csv`. `-With`, `-Without`, `-SteamExe` and `-AppId` configure only the launcher: the loadout, the Steam path and the app to launch.
- `-With` and `-Without` take local mod folder names or Workshop item ids, comma-separated.
- Probe names are lower case plurals of the thing sampled (`fridges`).
